messages.content: How do I run the same Python script on 50 input files without submitting 50 jobs by hand?

Use a job array: one submission, one task per file, and `$SLURM_ARRAY_TASK_ID` picks the file.

```bash
#!/bin/bash
#SBATCH --job-name=process
#SBATCH --array=0-49
#SBATCH --cpus-per-task=1
#SBATCH --mem=2G
#SBATCH --time=00:30:00
#SBATCH --output=logs/%x_%A_%a.out

files=(inputs/*.dat)
python process.py "${files[$SLURM_ARRAY_TASK_ID]}"
```

`%A` is the array job id and `%a` the task index, so each task gets its own log. Add `%10` to the range (`--array=0-49%10`) if you want at most 10 tasks running at once.
